judgment.rationale: Both are Class IX NCERT Learning Outcomes (same statement-type grain, same parent Class IX, identical rank 0), so any developmental direction would require substantive same-rank evidence, and none exists: LO2 is a classification skill (classifying materials/objects/organisms by properties, e.g. hierarchical plant/animal sub-groups, states and composition of matter) while LO15 is a descriptive/historical outcome about scientific discoveries and inventions (atomic models, cell and microscope, Lavoisier and Priestley, Archimedes principle). Neither proficiency is evidenced as supporting success in the other. There is, however, more than generic wording overlap: LO15 explicitly lists 'classification of living things' as a discovery to be described, which meaningfully reinforces the hierarchical classification of plants and animals targeted by LO2, giving substantive conceptual coherence without dependency. judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Class IX Indicators (rank 0, same canonical coordinate) under the same parent CLO7 ('Investigates the nature and properties of various types of chemical substances through experiments') in Chapter 2 'Is matter around us pure?'. C19 investigates types and properties of mixtures, solutions, colloids and suspensions via simple experiments; C20 plans tasks for preparing suspensions of soil, chalk powder and fine sand in water. The substantive overlap is specific and pair-relevant: C20's planned preparation of suspensions provides concrete hands-on material for the suspension strand of C19's investigation of types/properties, and C19's LC set includes an explicit 'investigates the types and properties of suspensions using simple experiments' component matching C20's suspension focus. This is complementary, mutually reinforcing laboratory work within one chapter rather than a demonstrated developmental dependency: the endpoints share the same Class rank and neither statement's evidence shows that proficiency in one is needed for or clearly elevates success in the other (investigation of mixtures/solutions/colloids extends well beyond suspension preparation, and planning a single preparation task is not a broadening of the investigative outcome). Same-rank direction therefore lacks the required substantive support, so the symmetric relation is recorded. Note that both endpoints' source evidence is truncated (24 omitted source-evidence items each) and all endpoints and ancestors carry upstream audit/merge context (including merged Chapter, Content Domain and LO3 organizers), so the judgment rests on the bounded indicator text, coordinates, hierarchy and LCs supplied.
